prompts.name: key
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: registered key illustration for a Windows animated desktop mascot named Pink-chan.
Input image 1 is the CHARACTER reference: preserve her vivid pink short twin ponytails, pink bob with straight fringe, two black bow ribbons with silver square buckles, three crossed silver hairpins on the viewer-left, magenta eyes, small silver drop earrings, and white/light lavender oversized zip jacket with charcoal and bright pink geometric panels and black ribbed cuffs over a black top. Simplify the silver pendant. No text.
Input image 2 is a PARTS REFERENCE SHEET: use ONLY panel 1 COMPOSITE as the layout, proportions, pose, drawing style, desk, keyboard and mouse. Other panels explain future layer separation. Do NOT draw a sheet or labels.
Draw ONE chibi illustration, 2 to 2.5 heads tall with a huge head and tiny body and small mitten hands, in exactly panel 1's front-left 3/4 composition facing to the right. Near arm on viewer lower-left rests on the mouse; far arm reaches right to the keyboard. Same wooden desk, same diagonal keyboard, same hand/shoulder positions as panel 1. NO raised greeting hand, no legs or skirt visible.
REGISTRATION: landscape canvas 1469 x 1071, entire panel-1 canvas recreated without its frame. Same camera, same head size, same eye/mouth/head position as panel 1. Head occupies approximately x=220..840, y=40..580, with some extra width for compact twin ponytails; leave at least 18 px transparent margin at top/left around hair. Neck at x=590 y=565. Far hand center about x=945 y=735; near hand about x=505 y=885. Desk extends to bottom and right canvas edge. Never recenter or crop hair.
Rig-friendly rules: neutral face eyes fully open and a tiny closed smiling mouth. Bangs above iris with clear skin around eyes and mouth. Hair compact and fully above collar, not crossing shoulders, chest, hands or arms. Short visible plain neck between closed chin contour and collar; change black high collar to a low collar so neck is visible, keep outfit recognizable. Both arms wear long roomy sleeves, visible elbow bend, unbroken dark cuff edge next to fully visible hands. Near sleeve continuous dark outline all the way to shoulder. No cables or accessories connecting separate moving parts. Twin ponytails short and entirely head-only.
Style like panel 1: thick even dark charcoal-brown outlines, charming rounded chibi, flat clean pastel colors with very minimal gentle shading. No gradients or cast shadows or glow. Transparent background with real alpha, NOT a colored rectangle or checkerboard. No text, no watermark, no border. Produce one high-quality key illustration.

prompts.name: base
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Precise registered layer extraction for 2D animation.
Image 1 is the approved Pink-chan KEY ILLUSTRATION, the only source of character pixels. Image 2 is a different character's parts reference sheet, showing only how to separate layers. Never copy its character.
CRITICAL REGISTRATION: output the full original canvas of image 1, exactly 1502 x 1047. Keep every retained pixel at exactly the same x,y position, scale, color, angle and outline as image 1. DO NOT crop to the part, recenter, zoom, translate or recompose. All original blank margins are retained even if most of the canvas is empty. Reconstruct only originally obscured areas explicitly requested. Remove excluded objects to genuine alpha transparency. No background, checkerboard, labels, text, grid or shadows. One single layer, never a sheet.
LAYER BASE, as panel 2: keep ONLY wooden desk and keyboard plus pink/lavender/black jacket TORSO including both shoulders, collar, black top and necklace, AND NECK. Remove entire head, all hair, earrings, BOTH arms with sleeves and hands, and mouse. Complete desk wood and keys where hands/mouse were. Complete torso under removed sleeves with same clothing design, complete shoulder outlines. Preserve outer dimensions of torso and all visible original torso pixels. Neck remains attached to body: plain skin column at exactly original neck x and original width, extending UP by about 70 pixels beneath original chin, no outline across hidden top. Collar remains unchanged. No hand or sleeve or hair fragments. Desk/keyboard position and scale absolutely unchanged.

prompts.name: face-expression
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is a registered head-only animation layer. Output the SAME ORIGINAL full 1502x1047 transparent canvas with the head in its EXACT original position, size, angle and colors. Edit ONLY BOTH EYES and MOUTH. 1. Both eyes gently CLOSED in a relaxed happy blink: a single curved dark lash line per eye, following the same original upper eyelid shape and position with a slight downward movement. Fill former eye area with the identical surrounding skin color. Do not move eyebrows, blush, hair or bangs. 2. Mouth OPEN in a tiny speaking smile about the same width as the tiny original w-shaped smile and 35-40 px tall. Keep the ORIGINAL w-shaped upper-lip contour at EXACTLY the original location. Below that contour draw a small dark warm interior and tiny pink tongue; no big grin. Everything else MUST be pixel-identical: hair, outline, accessories, skin, jaw, transparent margins. No neck or body. Do not crop, recenter, scale or beautify. No background, labels, text, shadow or stray pixels; actual transparent PNG. This layer is overlaid on the original head for animation; precise alignment is essential.

prompts.name: head-v2
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
Input is the exact approved key image. Perform ONLY an erasure edit: remove the desk, keyboard, mouse, torso, NECK, collar, necklace and both arms. Keep the entire head including every pink hair strand, black ribbon, silver hair clip, earrings, face, fully open eyes and closed w-mouth.
Most important: DO NOT REDRAW OR REINTERPRET THE HEAD. Its visible pixels, especially the top left ponytail, hair clips, bangs, eye outlines and chin must stay exactly as input, with ZERO shift or scale or outline changes. This is a registered animation layer, not a new portrait.
The head retains original 1502x1047 coordinates. Preserve original 1502x1047 full transparent canvas and large bottom/right margins. It remains in the UPPER LEFT. Do not crop to head.
Only complete the small hidden hair behind the neck where strictly needed. No neck, no skin below original chin line. No background glow, drop shadow, halo, texture, checkerboard, stray colored fragments or haze. Background alpha exactly zero. Only solid character with clean antialiasing along its outline. ONE transparent PNG.

prompts.name: face-expression-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a registered facial expression donor for this exact head layer. Same original 1502x1047 full canvas, same head position and size with large blank bottom and right margins. Modify ONLY eyes and mouth. Gently close both eyes as a relaxed blink: single dark lash curves at original eyes. Open the tiny w-smile below the ORIGINAL upper lip into a small 35-pixel-tall speaking mouth, warm dark interior, tiny tongue. Preserve all other pixels exactly, especially bangs, face skin tones and position. Head outline and hair must not change or move. Absolutely NO background of any kind: use clean genuine alpha, retain the original alpha outline exactly. No glow, halo, clouds, fog, grey patches, noise, shadow, texture outside the head, labels or text. Empty background stays fully transparent. No neck or torso. Do not crop, center or zoom the head.

prompts.name: eyes-closed
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Exact registered CLOSED-EYES animation donor, using this approved head image as the edit target.
Change ONLY the two eyes into a gentle peaceful blink. Each closed eye is ONE elegant tapered dark curved stroke, only 8 to 12 pixels thick at this resolution. NO broad black wedge, NO huge winged eyelashes, NO second eyelid line. Larger viewer-left closed eye spans approximately original canvas x=525..675 at y=480..500, a gentle upward arch like a relaxed smile. Smaller viewer-right closed eye spans x=751..816 at y=457..481, matching original perspective. Erase the entire old open eyes INCLUDING every thick black eyelash tip extending far left/right, leaving clean surrounding skin in its place. Iris and whites gone completely. Keep eyebrows and blush exactly unchanged.
Everything else MUST be identical to source: hair strands, bangs, silver pins, bows, earrings, head size and position, face contour, skin colors, original tiny closed w-shaped mouth. Do not open or modify the mouth. Do not alter ANY hair pixels or move the head. Retain original full 1502x1047 transparent canvas with large empty bottom/right margins. Clean real alpha, NO haze/glow/halo/background or text. This is for an animation overlay, not a redrawn portrait.
